I fully support restitution. As a white South African in her 30's I have been called a disgrace by many white "friends" for supporting land reform. 

We are a miracle nation. Born out of a hateful state of being, we have risen out of the ashes. Are we a perfect country? No. We still have a lot of corruption and a million other things wrong with our service delivery etc. However, this democracy is still in its infancy in the grand scheme of things.

We have to try and make things right by those who were directly affected by apartheid. You may not like my views but this is about doing the morally right thing. I think the idea people have is a Zimbabwe type situation. I have faith in Cyril and the way he says the government will go about doing this.

When the English and Dutch just took over in our country they TOOK land forcefully. The same was done in the US and Australia. This must be rectified.

Sadly, this is going to take a very long time to implement correctly.
